jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer & Consultant (all genders) – Microsoft Fabric
jobs.description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group steht die teccle wave für ganzheitliche Cloud-Lösungen und digitale Transformation im deutschen Mittelstand. Zur Verstärkung unseres eigenständigen siebenköpfigen Data-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Data-&-Analytics-Plattformen auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric, Azure und Power BI, um nachhaltige Mehrwerte für unsere Kund:innen zu schaffen

  • Aufbau skalierbarer Datenarchitekturen, Datenmodelle und Data Pipelines, die eine effiziente Integration, Aufbereitung und Nutzung von Unternehmensdaten ermöglichen

  • Verantwortung für die technische Konzeption und erfolgreiche Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Kundenprojekte – von der Analyse über Workshops bis zur Qualitätssicherung

  • Sicherstellung leistungsfähiger Reporting-, BI- und Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen, die datengetriebene Entscheidungen auf allen Ebenen unterstützen

  • Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, Stakeholdern und Projektteams, um Projekte effizient, transparent und zielgerichtet zum Erfolg zu führen

  • Einsatz innovativer Technologien wie Azure AI und Microsoft Foundry zur Erweiterung moderner Datenplattformen und AI-gestützter Analytics-Lösungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Data-, Analytics- oder Cloud-Umfeld mit – idealerweise im Consulting oder in kundenorientierten Projektlandschaften – und verfügst über fundiertes Know-how in Microsoft Fabric, Azure, OneLake, Data Lakes und modernen Datenarchitekturen

  • Du entwickelst, betreibst und optimierst skalierbare Cloud Data Platforms, ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Data Pipelines mit Microsoft Fabric, Python, SQL sowie modernen CI/CD- und Testing-Standards

  • Du besitzt Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Datenmodellierung, Lösungsarchitektur und Systemintegration; Kenntnisse in Power BI, Spark/PySpark, Azure AI, AI Foundry oder komplexen SaaS-Anbindungen sind ein zusätzliches Plus

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und kundenorientiert, kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern und überzeugst im agilen Projektumfeld mit professionellem Auftreten

  • Du interessierst dich für innovative Technologien, moderne AI- und Analytics-Lösungen sowie technische Projektverantwortung; Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie DP-600, DP-700, AZ-305 oder AI-102 sind willkommen

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Mid Market (Evergreen)
Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) m/f/x
jobs.description:
Location: Germany/Berlin/Stuttgart 

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Site Reliability Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will need to reside in Germany with legal working permits or residence permits.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain and manage new and existing infrastructure, balancing both proactive and reactive maintenance. 

  • Technical Problem Identification and Resolution: Identify technical problems and bottlenecks. Collaborate with the engineering team to resolve these issues efficiently. 

  • ISO Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and processes are in compliance with ISO standards, and assist in maintaining those certifications. 

  • Production Support: Work closely with engineering teams to ensure our developed tools and applications run smoothly in a production environment. 

  • Backup Management: Oversee and manage all system backups, ensuring Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are met. 

  • Release Management Support: Assist in managing software releases to minimize disruption and maximize uptime. 

  • Off-Duty Support: Participate in an off-duty or pager duty rotation to provide round-the-clock system reliability and support. 

  • Incident Review and Analysis: Lead postmortems following any system disruptions, and help identify ways to prevent future incidents. 

  • Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor system alerts and respond quickly to maintain system health and maximize uptime. 

  • Capacity Planning: Participate in planning server capacity, ensuring we can meet current and future demands 


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field. 

  • 7+ years of experience in site reliability engineering or a similar role.

  • 3+ years in SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles  

  • Experience supporting/coaching less experienced team members. 

  • Ability in building alerting and observability into all production systems (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch etc.)

  • Proven experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (ECS, EC2, etc) or Azure. 

  • Extensive experience using Terraform and Ansible. 

  • Incident management, postmortems, and on-call quality of life experience

  • Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and testing. 

  • Strong knowledge of system monitoring tools. 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues. 

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills. 

  • Proven experience managing system backups and understanding of RTO and RPO. 

  • Familiarity with release management processes. 

  • Ability to work in an on-call capacity. 

  • Define the Site Reliability Strategy and Execute on it 

  • Experience in managing Stakeholders and expectations from Stakeholders 

  • Experience in dealing with concurring priorities / context switching 

  • Proficiency in Python.

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in Germany, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion

 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (m/w/d) - remote oder Karlsruhe
jobs.description:
Wir bei Knuddels wollen soziale Netzwerke wieder wirklich sozial machen – weg vom Konsumieren von Content, hin zu echter menschlicher Nähe. Unser Ziel: Bei Knuddels soll jeder Mensch drei wichtige Menschen für sein echtes Leben finden.

Als Product Engineer verbindest du Produktmanagement, Design, Softwareentwicklung und Qualitätssicherung. Du begleitest Features von der Idee bis zur Weiterentwicklung nach dem Launch. Dabei übernimmst du eigenständig Verantwortung und bekommst fachliche Unterstützung aus dem Team.

So arbeiten wir

Wir arbeiten in kleinen Teams aus zwei bis vier Personen und kurzen Zyklen: Eine erste, sinnvoll nutzbare Version geht live, wir lernen aus Nutzerfeedback und entwickeln sie weiter.

Aktuell wachsen Teammitglieder aus spezialisierten Rollen in die Rolle als Product Engineer hinein. Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit dieser Arbeitsweise und gestaltest den Wandel mit. Unser Knuddels Operating System bündelt dafür Design System, Tooling, Wissen und KI-gestützte Test-Tools und wird gemeinsam weiterentwickelt.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Verstehen und priorisieren: Du leitest aus Daten und direktem Community-Feedback ab, welche Probleme du innerhalb unseres strategischen Rahmens als Nächstes angehst.

  • Gestalten und entwickeln: Du übersetzt Nutzerprobleme in durchdachte Feature-Konzepte: Ziele, Funktionsweise und Umfang definierst du ebenso wie UX/UI. Du setzt deine Lösungen technisch um und integrierst sie in unsere bestehende Codebasis. Dabei nutzt du KI-Tools gezielt und kannst den entstehenden Code verstehen, beurteilen und weiterentwickeln.

  • Qualität sichern: Du sicherst die Qualität deiner Features mit automatisierten und teilautomatisierten Test-Tools und holst dir bei Bedarf fachliche Unterstützung.

  • Veröffentlichen und verbessern: Du bringst nutzbare Versionen live, beobachtest ihre Wirkung und entwickelst sie technisch und funktional weiter.

  • Zusammenarbeiten und Wissen teilen: Du stimmst dich mit deinem Team, der Geschäftsführung und relevanten Stakeholdern ab und dokumentierst Entscheidungen und Learnings.


Was bieten wir dir?

  • Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Produktentwicklung: Bei uns bekommst du den Freiraum, Neues auszuprobieren und deine Features eigenverantwortlich von der Idee bis zum Release zu bringen. Kurze Entscheidungswege und KI im gesamten Entwicklungsprozess machen es möglich. Unser Knuddels Operating System liefert dir die Werkzeuge dafür.

  • Flexibilität, die sich Deinem Leben anpasst: Bis zu 100% Remote Work, Vertrauensarbeitszeit, 10 unbezahlte "Flexi-Urlaubstage" zusätzlich zu 30 Tagen Urlaub.

  • Echter Zusammenhalt: Eine offene, respektvolle und kooperative Kultur.

  • Wachstum nach Deinen Vorstellungen: 10% deiner Arbeitszeit für Weiterbildung, Coaching-Pool, Inhouse-Workshops, regelmäßiges Feedback.

  • Fokus auf unser eigenes Produkt (B2C): Du siehst unmittelbar, wie dein Beitrag bei unserer Community ankommt.

  • Exzellente Ausstattung: Hervorragendes technisches Equipment, bei vollständig remote Arbeit zusätzlich ein Zuschuss zum mobilen Klimagerät.

  • Büro in Top-Lage (Karlsruhe): Kostenloses Frühstücksbuffet, täglich frisch gekochtes Mittagessen, voll klimatisiert, riesige Dachterrasse.

  • Gesundheit: Zuschuss zum Fitnessstudio/Sportverein.

  • alle Benefits findest auch nochmal unter jobs.knuddels.de

Was bieten wir nicht?

  • Staubige Konzernstrukturen

  • Arbeiten an Geschäftskundenprojekten (Wir sind ein B2C-Unternehmen)

  • Erfahrung: Du hast Features bereits über Produktmanagement, Design, eigene Softwareentwicklung und QA hinweg verantwortet. Du musst nicht überall gleich stark sein; entscheidend ist praktische Erfahrung über alle vier Bereiche.

  • Technik und KI: Du beherrschst mindestens eine moderne Programmiersprache, hast Web-Anwendungen bzw. APIs gebaut und betrieben und nutzt KI-gestützte Coding-Tools im Alltag. Java, Spring Boot, Svelte, React und TypeScript sind ein Plus.

  • Produkt und UX: Du verstehst Nutzerprobleme, entwickelst gut bedienbare Lösungen und begründest Entscheidungen mit Feedback und Daten.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eigenständig, holst dir gezielt Unterstützung und kommunizierst Entscheidungen und Zielkonflikte klar dem Team gegenüber.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse.

jobs.title: Portfolio Accountant
jobs.description:
Access Your Potential.
Join us to create and deliver experiences that inspire people, spark connection, and bring imagination to life—while having a lot of fun doing it.

About the Job

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and organized Portfolio Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team! In this role, you’ll manage the day-to-day accounting operations for an assigned Access territory, ensuring accurate financial records, timely reporting, and effective financial support for territory operations.

Working closely with territory leadership and the broader Finance & Accounting team, you’ll oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger transactions, month-end closing activities, and financial reporting. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently, solving problems, and building strong relationships with internal teams while keeping financial operations running smoothly.

What You'll Be Doing

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Manage day-to-day accounting activities for an assigned territory, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger transactions.

  • Process supplier payments, client deposits, final payments, expense reports, and journal entries accurately and within established deadlines.

  • Prepare and maintain general ledger entries, account reconciliations, and supporting financial documentation.

  • Complete month-end closing activities, ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date.

  • Enter territory actuals into monthly budget comparison worksheets, review results for discrepancies, and flag variances for Controller review.

  • Monitor territory revenue, expenses, and cash flow to support accurate financial reporting.

  • Provide financial information and supporting documentation to the Controller and Finance & Accounting leadership.

Territory Accounting Support

  • Serve as a primary accounting resource for employees within the assigned territory.

  • Partner with territory leadership and internal departments to resolve accounting-related questions and discrepancies.

  • Review and submit territory-specific labor and staffing reports in accordance with established procedures.

  • Support territory budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting activities as assigned.

  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions to support ongoing territory operations.

Compliance & Financial Accuracy

  • Maintain accurate accounting records in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.

  • Assist with internal and external audits by maintaining organized financial records and supporting documentation.

  • Ensure accounting activities are completed in accordance with established procedures and reporting deadlines.

Training & Team Collaboration

  • Provide accounting-related guidance and training to new employees within the assigned territory as needed.

  • Collaborate with the Finance & Accounting team to ensure consistent application of established procedures, communicate accounting concerns, and escalate issues as appropriate.

  • Support additional territory-level accounting projects and responsibilities as assigned.

About You

We know that there’s no one in the world like you. And we know that you have a lot to offer the next company you work with. Below is a list of “nice-to-haves”, but don’t let those deter you from applying. Access believes that an inclusive team and culture is important. We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • 1–3 years of accounting experience preferred, ideally within hospitality, destination management, or a related industry.

  • Working knowledge of general accounting principles, accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger processes, and financial reconciliations.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with accounting or financial management systems (such as Yardi, MRI, Investran, or similar).

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to financial accuracy.

  • Ability to independently manage recurring accounting responsibilities and consistently meet established deadlines.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve accounting discrepancies.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills when working with territory employees and internal stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent Financial Accuracy: Territory financial records, reconciliations, and reporting are accurate, complete, and maintained with minimal corrections or rework.

  • Timely & Reliable Execution: Month-end close activities, financial transactions, and reporting requirements are consistently completed within established deadlines.

  • Effective Problem-Solving: Accounting discrepancies are identified and addressed promptly, with appropriate escalation of complex issues or financial variances.

  • Trusted Territory Partnership: Territory employees and leadership receive responsive, knowledgeable accounting support, with clear communication and dependable follow-through.

Why Access?

We’re a women-owned, award-winning destination management company with teams in cities coast to coast. For 50+ years, we’ve been producing high-impact events and experiences for global brands—and we’re just getting started.

 

CULTURE & EXTRAS

  • Certified as a Great Place to Work – 3 years in a row and counting!

  • 55+ years in the industry!

  • Women-owned and women-led

  • Fun, creative, and supportive culture

  • Focus on recognition and employee value – including annual and quarterly awards

  • Paid day off to serve your local community

  • Annual all-company retreat to connect, learn, and have fun together

  • Annual qualifier-based incentive trip for top performers (certain departments eligible)

  • Regional team outings

  • Monthly companywide meetings to connect, learn, and celebrate wins

  • Paid Sabbatical leave after 7 years of service!

 

COMPENSATION

  • Highly competitive total compensation, including strong base salary and quarterly bonuses

  • Very strong performance-based quarterly commission plans

  • 401k with company match (eligible after 1 year – up to 4% of salary matched, vested immediately)

  • Monthly cell phone stipend

 

WORK LIFE BALANCE

  • Flexible schedule opportunities

  • Generous PTO

  • Sick days

  • 9 full holidays

  • 5 half days off prior to holidays to unplug early

  • 2 floating holidays off to be used on holidays of your choice

HEALTH, WELLNESS, AND FAMILY

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

  • Mentorship program

jobs.title: Events Auditor Associate
jobs.description:
Access Your Potential.
Join us to create and deliver experiences that inspire people, spark connection, and bring imagination to life—while having a lot of fun doing it.

About the Job

We're seeking a detail-oriented and organized Events Auditing Associate to join our Finance & Accounting team! In this role, you'll support the billing and financial closeout process for familiarization (FAM) programs, as well as supplier referral invoicing. You'll also work closely with territory Events Auditors to prepare billing documentation, review program financials, and ensure accurate and timely program closeouts.

The ideal candidate enjoys working with numbers, has a strong attention to detail, and is comfortable managing multiple priorities. You'll collaborate with Event Managers, Sales Managers, Accounting, and other internal teams to track outstanding items, resolve discrepancies, and keep program financial records organized and up to date.

What You'll Be Doing

Program Reporting & Tracking

  • Maintain and update the master program closeout report throughout the day as changes are received, including new programs, outstanding items, invoices sent, and completed closeouts.

  • Utilize the master program closeout report to track familiarization program and supplier referral invoices sent to clients and suppliers throughout the closeout process.

  • Ensure program closeout reports and tracking documentation remain accurate and up to date.

Financial Reconciliation & Program Closeouts

  • Retrieve program ledger reports from financial systems as needed.

  • Review program closeout documentation against program ledgers to verify accuracy and identify discrepancies.

  • Identify and verify charges not reflected in the program ledger, including outstanding payment requests and expenses recorded in financial systems.

  • Document and flag outstanding items, discrepancies, and additional information needed to complete program closeouts.

  • Partner with Event Managers to obtain missing information and resolve outstanding items.

  • Collaborate with Accounting regarding discrepancies and necessary corrections identified within financial and payment systems.

  • Document findings and communicate outstanding items to the appropriate team members throughout the closeout process.

  • Assist territory Events Auditors with preparing final billing statements and completing closeouts for revenue-based programs as needed.

Supplier Referrals

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d)

Remote job

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer

You'll help build Recare's Operator, our agent that gets AI-generated clinical output into hospital systems by operating their existing software the way a person would, no bespoke interface required. It's the sharp end of our integration strategy: a Windows desktop application that automates UI interactions with hospital systems, running on doctors' devices and often inside RDP or Citrix environments. The first version is already live – you'll help expand its capabilities and make it reliable in production.

  • You build and improve integrations between hospital systems and Recare products.

  • You implement and harden computer-use automation flows so they work reliably in production, including edge cases, recovery, and safety rails.

  • You partner with clinical domain experts to turn ambiguous workflows into shippable plans and robust implementations that solve real customers' needs.

  • You contribute across the stack as needed, including our Go-based gateway.

  • You invest in observability foundations (logs, metrics, traces) so we can trust the system in production.

How we work:

  • AI-native – our engineers reach for frontier coding agents every day to move fast across the whole stack, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Frontier models – we build on the best models available and adopt new capabilities as they ship, not a release later.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and validation loops that make that real.

  • Unglamorous foundations – engineers get the time to build the eval harnesses, guardrails, and observability that make AI trustworthy in production, not just the feature on top.

  • Ship and observe – always deployable, telemetry-driven, fix in the open.


Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer

  • You're a builder with a hacker mindset: you default to building rather than waiting, and you're solution-oriented rather than problem-oriented.

  • You have professional backend experience in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you can point to production software you shipped and owned.

  • You're comfortable working on integration-heavy systems: APIs, workflows, data models, auth, and real-world edge cases.

  • You're pragmatic about reliability: you care about monitoring, debugging, test coverage, and making systems operable.

  • You're excited to use AI coding agents daily and have opinions on how to use them effectively.

  • You're ambitious but frustration-tolerant. Hospital IT is complicated and progress is hard-won; you stay relentless, get your hands dirty, and iterate until it works.

  • You communicate confidently in English and collaborate well across Product, Engineering, and Operations.

Nice to have:

  • German language skills.

  • Experience with Electron or TypeScript on the desktop side.

  • Experience with healthcare IT systems (HIS, KIS, PVS, EMR) and interoperability standards such as HL7 v2 or FHIR.

Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d)

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we continue to grow – and we're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What to expect as our Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

You'll be our first dedicated security engineer: a senior IC with no team at the start. You join as Deputy CISO, report to our Director of Technology (currently acting CISO), and build security engineering from scratch. The baseline is already in place – ISO 27001, C5 Type II, regular penetration tests, and encryption in the product. AI is adding new surfaces: voice documentation, document generation, and agentic workflows. You build and own the security program, the tooling, and the security story we tell customers.

  • Vulnerability management – scanners and dependency updates across repos, plus the process that gets findings closed.

  • Partner to Platform – review security-sensitive infrastructure decisions and explore options like customer-managed keys or HSMs. Platform still owns architecture.

  • Certifications, technical side – control design and assessments for our ISO 27001 and C5 setup, the security case for a potential upcoming Class IIa medical device (MDR), and pentest scoping and follow-up, with regulation like the EU Cyber Resilience Act on the horizon. This is roughly a quarter to a third of the role, and we say it openly: for the right person in healthcare security, it's a draw, not a chore.

  • Customer security – reusable docs, evidence, and AI-assisted questionnaires, so the tenth enterprise deal costs a fraction of the first. You join the call when a hospital CISO asks something new about our AI architecture.

  • Incident response – process, runbooks, and escalation, and you lead when it's real. We're too small for a SOC, so you design on-call that fits a company our size. Product incidents and platform bugs have their own owners in engineering.

  • Company-wide security – watch the threat landscape, turn this week's supply-chain mess into concrete actions, and set the baselines IT applies to devices and accounts.

How we work:

  • AI-native – our engineers use coding agents every day. Security should too: scanning, evidence, questionnaires.

  • AI is also our attack surface – agent sandboxing, prompt injection, voice data, computer-use automation inside hospitals. We deal with security questions most companies will only meet in a few years.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control.

  • Ship and observe – we ship continuously and debug from telemetry, including in the open when that's the fastest path.


Here's how we picture you as our Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

  • You're a hands-on security engineer with 6+ years across software and security engineering, and you can point to a security program (or a big part of one) you've owned.

  • You've been the technical counterpart through at least one ISO 27001, C5, or SOC 2 certification cycle: you've designed controls, faced an auditor, and written the technical side of a Statement of Applicability. This is a hard requirement.

  • You've run vulnerability management somewhere real: scanners, dependency bots, triage, and the follow-through that gets things fixed.

  • You follow the security scene closely (podcasts, advisories, incident write-ups) and usually have an opinion on this week's incident before it reaches the news.

  • You're genuinely curious about AI security – both securing AI systems (agents, sandboxing, data flows) and using AI tooling to work at leverage.

  • You can talk to engineers, auditors, and hospital security teams in English without a slide deck translating for you.

Nice to have:

  • German language skills, since our customers and the C5 world are German-speaking.

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain.

  • Offensive security experience.

  • Security certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, or similar.

jobs.title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.


What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

  • Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement.

  • Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories.

  • Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany).

  • Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones.

  • Together: team meetups and company-wide events.

Location

We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.
